qualification: Actual source128 grey energy/time/outer-state histories; frequency shapes remain explicit proxy alternatives, not new spectral radiation transport.
Prompt and slow material peaks are separated in time; do not add their isolated maxima as simultaneous.
All source records/traces and the one metadata-only adapter are recorded.
k50/cp1800 and shallow k4/cp1800 are required-property sensitivities, not measured irradiated assemblies.
The first-interaction finite-depth result does not certify electron transport, secondary scattering, fluorescence or layered thermal contact.
